mapper.select: SELECT id, account, display_name, status FROM iam.users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, status, auth_revision FROM iam.tenants WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, status, auth_revision FROM iam.tenants WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, code, name, status, auth_revision FROM iam.tenants WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY code, id
SELECT id, status, revision FROM iam.tenant_memberships WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, status, revision FROM iam.tenant_memberships WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO iam.tenant_memberships(tenant_id, user_id, status, revision, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, 'active', 1, #{createdBy}) RETURNING id
SELECT id, code, is_builtin, status FROM iam.roles WHERE scope = 'tenant' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = #{code}
SELECT id, code, is_builtin, status FROM iam.roles WHERE scope = 'tenant' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = #{code} FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO iam.roles(scope, tenant_id, code, name, description, is_builtin) VALUES ('tenant', #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, false) RETURNING id
SELECT id, code, resource_code, status FROM iam.permissions WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT id, code, resource_code, status FROM iam.permissions WHERE code IN #{code} ORDER BY code
SELECT code, name_zh, sort FROM iam.resource_catalog WHERE code LIKE 'agent:business:%' AND status = 'active' AND kind = 'leaf' ORDER BY sort, code
SELECT p.code FROM iam.role_permissions rp JOIN iam.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam.role_permissions(role_id, permission_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{permissionId}, #{grantedBy}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam.membership_roles WHERE membership_id = #{membershipId} AND role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam.membership_roles(tenant_id, membership_id, role_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{membershipId}, #{roleId}, #{grantedBy}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT status, revision FROM iam.tenant_entitlements WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND resource_code = #{resourceCode}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO iam.tenant_entitlements(tenant_id, resource_code, status, revision, granted_at, revoked_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{resourceCode}, 'active', 1, now(), NULL, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_code) DO UPDATE SET status = 'active', revision = iam.tenant_entitlements.revision + 1, granted_at = now(), revoked_at = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE iam.tenant_entitlements.status <> 'active'
mapper.select: SELECT auth_revision FROM iam.tenants WHERE id = #{tenantId}
SELECT revision FROM iam.tenant_memberships WHERE id = #{membershipId}

SELECT p.id, p.code, p.scope, p.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam.role_permissions rp WHERE rp.permission_id = p.id) AS role_edges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam.service_account_permissions sap WHERE sap.permission_id = p.id) AS service_account_edges FROM iam.permissions p WHERE p.code IN #{code} ORDER BY p.code
SELECT n.nspname || '.' || c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND (n.nspname || '.' || c.relname) IN #{name} ORDER BY 1
